appName: VR Relaxing – Over the Silk Tree Bloom
displayName: VR Relaxing – Over the Silk Tree Bloom
display_name: VR Relaxing – Over the Silk Tree Bloom
display_long_description:
One tree – in the middle of a city park. You're not walking beside it. You're floating above it, surrounded by soft pink blossoms and looking down at winding paths, benches, and quiet greenery. It’s a view you’d never get in real life – not without a drone, a ladder, and a lot of luck. And certainly not as a peaceful break. VRtravelX makes that perspective possible.

You’re not flying. You’re not moving. But your senses are. Every slight movement of your head reveals a subtle shift in light, color, and depth. The tree below shimmers gently. The park beneath becomes background noise – distant, quiet, almost forgotten. There’s no narration, no direction, no pressure. VRtravelX strips everything down to presence: stillness, breath, space.

This isn’t travel. It’s a pause. Not an escape, but a soft reset. Floating above nature, in a moment no one normally gets to experience – too calm, too high, too beautiful to stumble upon in a normal day. And that’s exactly why it works. VRtravelX offers you something rare: a perspective that doesn’t exist in your daily life, delivered with care, stillness, and depth.

This app includes streamed experiences and requires a stable internet connection. 
Streamed content is provided by the developer and may not be available indefinitely.
